correctness.rationale: Vandermonde plus exact valuations v2(binomial(2^s,j))=s−v2(j) prove D(n+2^s)=D(n) mod 2^(s+2) for every n and s≥2. Exact binomial valuation at n=1 excludes each 2-power half-period for r≥6; separate exact cases exclude it for r=3,4,5, and mod2/mod4 boundaries are explicit. Since any least period divides a known 2-power period, this proves all exponents, not just finite checks. The packaged verifier replays exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: The function r↦P(r) is a natural exact arithmetic invariant of a classical lattice-path sequence under prime-power reduction. Complete all-r classification detects the exceptional plateau at r=3,4 and proves exact period doubling thereafter; quantitative sharpness is not obtainable from selected-index convergence alone. It offers a uniform tool for modular Delannoy computation and distinguishes pure periodicity from mere automaticity.
